title: Studying at Fisk and the move to Chicago
summary: At Fisk she was told she had talent but poor technique and was started over on scales; her mother then moved to Chicago.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Yes. They claimed that, um, I had talent, but I had been poorly taught.
I know a lot of teachers are that way. I could,

yes, I could read anything they'd put up, but, I hadn't been taught technique, so they started me all over again, on scales, and using my fingers, uh, correctly. Well, I went to Fisk, two and a half years, and my mother moved to Chicago.
So, when did you get here?
